contentList.content: Giant Strength
Your Strength increases to 23, increases to 27 at 10th level, and increases to 31 at 20th level.
Guardian Chain
Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Resistance">resistance</LSTag> to all damage types.
Aura of Murder
Emanate a murderous aura that intimidates enemies within 3 meters. This ability can be toggled on and off.
Titan Shooting
Your ranged weapon attacks deal additional <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag><LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">modifier</LSTag> physical damage.
Widen Wounds
Deal an additional 1d6 <LSTag Tooltip="Force">force</LSTag> damage on critical hits.
Tragic Critical
When you score a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag>, you deal an additional 7 damage. Can be learned multiple times.
Lethal Strike
The number required to score a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag> is reduced by 1. Can be learned multiple times.
Quick Hands
Gain an additional <LSTag Tooltip="BonusAction">bonus action</LSTag>. Can be learned multiple times.
Cantrip Master
You can cast cantrips as an <LSTag Tooltip="Action">action</LSTag> instead of a <LSTag Tooltip="BonusAction">bonus action</LSTag>.
Agonizing Blast
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your chosen ability modifier, and that ability score increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Strength)
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier_Strength">Strength modifier</LSTag>, and your Strength increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Dexterity)
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier_Dexterity">Dexterity modifier</LSTag>, and your Dexterity increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Constitution)
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier_Constitution">Constitution modifier</LSTag>, and your Constitution increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Intelligence)
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier_Intelligence">Intelligence modifier</LSTag>, and your Intelligence increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Wisdom)
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier_Wisdom">Wisdom modifier</LSTag>, and your Wisdom increases by 1.
Agonizing Blast (Charisma)
Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier_Charisma">Charisma modifier</LSTag>, and your Charisma increases by 1.
